name: WordPress (software)
summary: Free, open-source software for building websites and blogs on your own hosting.
description: WordPress is open-source software for creating a website, blog or app. This record covers the software from WordPress.org, which you install on web hosting you choose; the software itself costs nothing, but hosting and a domain name usually do. Thousands of themes and plugins extend it, and the official Learn WordPress site offers free courses and lessons. Note: this is different from hosted website services that use the WordPress name.

pricing.free_tier_details: The software is released under the GPLv2 (or later).
pricing.costs_beyond_price: You need web hosting and usually a domain name; the official site directs you to 'find hosting' separately.

key_capabilities.text: Open-source software for creating a website, blog or app.
Official documentation and free learning resources are available from WordPress.org.

limitations.text: Requires separate web hosting; the software alone does not put a site online.
You are responsible for updates, backups and security of your site, including any plugins you install.

best_for: Blogs and small-business sites that may grow over time
People who want to own and move their site freely
not_ideal_for: Someone who wants a site live in minutes with no setup or maintenance
getting_started: Choose web hosting (many hosts offer WordPress installation).
Install WordPress and pick a simple theme.
Follow a beginner course on Learn WordPress to build your first pages.

sources.title: WordPress.org home page
sources.quote: Open source software which you can use to easily create a beautiful website, blog, or app.
